messages:
olivia: FYI: We're going to rename the internal proxy routing header in SDKs from `x-rd-route` -> `x-rd-proxy-route` in the next minor. This will affect routing decisions + quota attribution in Console. Planning canary next week.

raj: Which SDKs + timeline? Will it be a breaking change for customers who read headers directly?

olivia: Python / TS / Go — all three will get the bump. It should be non-breaking for most users because we'll ship a server-side fallback. Timeline: canary Tue 09:00 PDT, wide Wed. Server will accept both headers for a 30d compatibility window.

leo: We also need telemetry updates — current events capture `route_header`. We'll add `route_header_v2` and emit both for the window. Who owns Console mapping for attribution?

sasha: @eng-platform I'll own the server shim and acceptance tests. devex @olivia please add a migration snippet and release note.

olivia: Example fallback snippet for SDKs (to include in release notes):
```python
# preferred header, but keep legacy for compatibility
headers['x-rd-proxy-route'] = route_tag
# legacy header fallback
headers.setdefault('x-rd-route', route_tag)
```
```ts
// TS client
headers['x-rd-proxy-route'] = route;
if (!headers['x-rd-route']) headers['x-rd-route'] = route;
```

raj: On the routing side: router should evaluate v2 first, then legacy if absent. Any perf impact?

sasha: Router change is minimal: check for `x-rd-proxy-route` then `x-rd-route`. No extra DB calls, only header parsing -> CPU impact negligible. Updated acceptance tests live at https://ci.redwood.example/route-proxy (PR tests passing).

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for SDKs @09:00 PDT (build 5583) :rocket:

leo: For Console dashboards I'll add a temporary mapping layer that consumes `route_header_v2` and falls back to `route_header`. Dashboard tile will show traffic split by proxy header (v2/v1) and preserve original quota attribution for 30 days. Need the final event schema from eng-platform to wire charts.

olivia: I'll open the release-notes PR + migration guide checklist (snippet, queries to verify attribution, rollback steps). @devex please prepare a short docs tile and migration email.

raj: Sounds good. Soft-deprecate legacy header for 30 days then remove fallback afterwards. Sync on Thurs if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
